title: The stick figure, found
logline: A 2006 daily from Box 7 on the table: the stick-figure chorus in the back of a panel, and one of them drawn looking out of the strip at the reader. The page draws the page and adds nothing. He'd forgotten that one.

panels.composition: A drafting table under the lamp with an old newspaper daily laid on it, a row of tiny stick figures along the bottom of one panel and one of them turned to face out of the strip.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a drafting table under a lamp with an old four-panel newspaper comic laid on it showing a row of tiny stick figures along one panel's bottom with one turned to face outward, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
